about: Banned habits: constructs copied from older Pages that break, rot, or only work on the platform. The verifier reports each match as error `banned-<id>`; core.md explains each one. Matchers: `element` (tag name), `attribute` (attribute-name regex), `attributeValue` (value regex, optionally limited by an `attributes` name regex), `class` (regex on whole class tokens), `html` (regex on text and attribute values, comments ignored), `css` (regex on stylesheet.css, comments ignored), `parameterKey` (regex on the keys of a `*-parameters` object), `repeatWithoutMax` (an ng-repeat over the variable of that attribute Widget, on the same element or an ancestor, without the `max` attribute), `handBuiltTabs` (two or more elements whose attribute of that name sets the same variable to different literals).

habits.habit: <ods-tabs> is a platform-only directive, not in the Page bundle
The native map join (join-context with local-key/remote-key) is a server-side v1 analyze call that cannot carry the boundary context's filters and fails silently on mismatched key types
habits.replacement: the join by hand: ods-color-gradient (or a value-to-colour map) into color-categories + color-by-field on the boundary layer, keys cast with ''+

habits.habit: A *-domain attribute loads data from another portal; Pages use data.gr.ch only
habits.replacement: a data.gr.ch dataset, for boundaries an entry of the Boundary Dataset catalogue

habits.habit: auto-resize makes a Widget follow the iframe height, which breaks the fixed Target Height (ADR 0002)
habits.replacement: a parent with a fixed px height derived from --target-height

habits.habit: color="range-custom" resolves to nothing without the portal's chartColors and falls back to the default palette
habits.replacement: the CI category colours as a JSON array or hex value in color, or category-colors on ods-chart-query

habits.habit: The ods-box class is platform-only CSS (front-angular.css) and does not exist in the CI base stylesheet
habits.replacement: the card classes of the CI base stylesheet

habits.habit: svelte-* classes are copied from the portal's generated markup and change with every portal build
habits.replacement: the classes of the CI base stylesheet

habits.habit: The Bootstrap grid (container, row, col-*) is platform-only CSS from front-angular.css
habits.replacement: the layout shapes of the CI base stylesheet

habits.habit: $root.shared passes state through the root scope, outside every context, and goes stale
habits.replacement: context parameters: read ctx.parameters['refine.x'] where the context is in scope, or copy one filter with the one-way copy

habits.habit: The currentLanguage filter is platform-only and does not exist in ods-widgets; Pages are German only
habits.replacement: German text written directly into the Page

habits.habit: Viewport heights (100vh and other vh units) follow the iframe instead of the fixed Target Height (ADR 0002)
habits.replacement: fixed px heights derived from --target-height with calc()

habits.habit: A q (full-text query) parameter used as a filter matches text anywhere in a record, is translated to qv1 for ODSQL Widgets, and silently over- or under-matches
habits.replacement: refine.<field> / exclude.<field> context parameters, or ods-adv-analysis-where for computed conditions

habits.habit: A hard-coded year or period goes stale when the dataset is updated
habits.replacement: the latest period computed from the data (Pattern 3: facet sorted -num, or ods-adv-analysis max(…) with the guarded default)

habits.habit: ods-results fetches 10 records by default, so an ng-repeat over it silently stops at 10 rows
habits.replacement: an explicit ods-results-max on the ods-results element, or ods-table for long lists

habits.habit: Tabs built by hand with ng-click and ng-if/ng-show skip the tab bar styling, keyboard handling and the map rebuild of ods-simple-tabs
habits.replacement: ods-simple-tabs with one ods-simple-tab per Visualization (Pattern 8)
